title: Google Maps places
description: Two row types share one dataset: place (one Google Maps place, charged) and status (one per search, free).

dataset.title: Google Maps places
dataset.description: One flat row per place with contact, reputation, status and lead-helper columns, plus one free status row per search that accounts for every place found, filtered, deduplicated, delivered and charged.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered, duplicate and error tallies, and its HTTP and crawl stats.
